summary:
Independent design review APPROVE for frozen TASK-0134 spec e2fbd8115e4fab122cf4d328001c84fb5a00d2541171df34270fc5864f05ba8b and current context3ce3c3ed552cd7decace14a0bd1179fe766450c21366a07ab467fefa6bc1d579 on base77f086a0c93679a58e19e729bf81c115a4761766, under unchanged Policyfac8afbe8e1f671338eadc02697a66a3c6aa9ca5494eb25ea97b80812bce4727 and REVIEW/V2 classification4537c33bfd7182331064ac72c2d2375d0b59ed3dfc45e5ddaab873ff781c183b. No open critical/high/medium design findings. Reviewed actual specification, scope/facts/context and the frozen installed-engine design including the 0e9f337/77f086a contract. This reviewer authored the separate probe baseline test file and contributed earlier design research, but did not author either proposed production module or the frozen task specification; this is not an independent test-code review or a test PASS.

The bounded two-module design is sufficient for a closed primitive rather than a Node lifecycle activation. Immutable prepared inputs bind actual task/version/context and ordinary installed distribution/dependency/startup/RECORD bytes, fixed probes/protocol/operators and supported interpreter/host facts. The interpreter standard library, loader and OS remain explicitly trusted rather than represented as a hermetic closure. Fixed isolated startup, fresh empty pycache-prefix, copied-site origins/bytes/actual guard references and unchanged original inventories address stale bytecode and wrong-engine substitution. The installed001 transformation keeps full positive-control acceptance and admits only the precise missing-targeted alternate; the four compatible native AST operators may be reused without altering native execution or native declarations.

Preparing IMPLEMENTING native-V2 task/context facts does not start verification. The recorder re-prepares and compares the expected input digest, validates current spec/action approvals and distinct implementer/verifier labels, accepts only installed_engine_mutation_v1 and its dedicated file/receipt/claim namespace, and uses the existing consumption lock plus exclusive launch claim. Native targeted_mutation_v2 authorizations and spent old-task actions do not satisfy this contract. Failure or interruption retains spent authority and originals instead of retrying or deleting. Generic action approval alone cannot interpret the canonical kind/inputs_sha256 summary; the recorder must check it and current classification before any launch.

The pure reader accepts only caller-validated current immutable facts and rereads closed references, inventories, approval/consumption/launch/completion originals, reports, raw streams and complete Job receipts; it never collects live Git, restores state or starts processes. Dataclass construction is not authority. All-five-killed requires each genuine baseline exit0 and exactly the designated mutant call-phase AssertionError/observations/anchor with other cases and phases passed, plus empty Job/EOF/confirmed cleanup. Setup/import/teardown errors, survived mutants, arbitrary exit1, incomplete reports and unknown cleanup cannot substitute for killed. Separate baseline/unknown-selection tests, report/reader rejection tests, actual ordinary-wheel pairs and independent replay remain required; no mocked complete PASS may replace them.

Old TASK-0133 scope is carried history only and must remain unchanged, not current approval for this task. Public Node V2, CI, profiles/Policy/evidence versions and lifecycle consumers remain closed, with no target writes, authorization/threshold changes, native mutation redesign, model calls, private transfer or remote setting changes. The actual source candidate must still pass fresh focused checks, both wheel builds and source-independent installed acceptance, complete native V2 at unchanged85total/90diff thresholds and every required check/five original native mutations, current separately authorized action, independent implementation review, same-verifier finalization and Gate, then exact-head required remote CI. This design record performs none of those actions and establishes no implementation or acceptance success.
